Investorsˇ  Top Of Mind
Q1. What were the key developments in Q2 FY27? 
Our consolidated Total Income grew 44% YoY, with 27% growth in Total Transacting Users and 46% growth in Total 
Customer Assets. We added 11 lakh NTUs during the quarter, propelled by primary market activity. 42 lakh users applied 
for equity IPOs via Groww, resulting in a 22% market share in total allotments.

We saw increased contribution across most products, like MTF and Commodity Derivatives. While the share of Equity 
Derivatives in Total Income declined 12.2pp YoY, driven by market adjustments to CAS, we believe this will recover once 
the recommendations from SEBI
ˇs consultation paper go into effect. 

Consolidated expenses increased 29% YoY, with PAT 54% higher YoY, delivering a PAT margin of 47% (+3.0pp YoY).

We continue to scale our new businesses, with our Wealth Assets crossing ¹10,000 crores and our AMC AUM expanding 145% YoY to ¹7,1 7,179 crores.

In Q2, we saw increased contribution from MTF (+5.5pp YoY), Commodity Derivatives (+6.0pp YoY), and Other Operating 
Income (facilitated by strong primary activity in the quarter), whereas Equity Derivatives activity was softer. The 
contribution of Stocks, which comprises brokerage (70-75% of Stocks revenue) and other revenue (25-30%) which 
includes DP, DDPI, pledge charges and autosquareoff, also decreased marginally YoY. 

While this quarterˇs s quantum was outsized, broadly, we expect the growth of products which are not yet fully penetrated, 
like MTF and Commodity Derivatives, to be higher, leading to increased contribution from them in the coming quarters. 
Q3. What was the impact of the Closing Auction System (CAS) on your business?
Effective 3 August 2026, SEBI introduced the Closing Auction System (CAS) for F&O eligible stocks, replacing the earlier 
Volume-Weighted Average Price (VWAP) method with a 20-minute closing auction (3:15 PM to 3:35 PM). 
During the initial adoption phase, a disparity emerged between the 3:15 PM reference price (3:00 3:15 PM VWAP) and 
the equilibrium price published from 3:20 PM, leading to a decline in volumes across the industry. 

While our Equity Derivatives revenue declined 14.3% QoQ, the bulk of which we attribute to CAS, this was in-line with 
the decline that the industry has seen. 

The consultation paper published by SEBI proposes to delink derivatives settlement from CAS closing prices, which, if 
implemented, should help in normalising trading activity.

Q6. Could you please provide an update on your Wealth offerings?
We completed the Fisdom integration during the quarter, which will now enable us to provide Wealth offerings across 
multiple platforms. Currently, we provide the following products across our platforms:
Groww: Bonds and MF Prime
W: Mutual Funds, Insurance, AIF, PMS, in-house MF PMS, supported by wealth partners
Fisdom: Mutual Funds, supported by bank partners 
We will continue to expand the suite of wealth products being offered across all our platforms. This consolidation is 
reflected in our Unit Economics and KPI Handbook.
Q7. How has the performance of Groww AMC been?
Groww AMCˇs AUM grew 145% YoY from ¹2,928 crores to ¹7,179 crores, with the share of actively managed AUM 
increasing from 47% to 57%. Revenue for the AMC continued to grow in the quarter, up 131% YoY, while the bottom-li
ne was -¹8 8.3 crores.

Glossary
KPIs
Definitions
Platform Metrics
Total Transacting Users1
Total Transacting Users is the sum total of new transacting users acquired as of the end of the reporting 
period whereby a 'New Transacting User' (
˝NTU˛) is a user who has (i) deposited or invested ¹1,0 1,000 or more 
and has undertaken a transaction, or (ii) has taken a loan for the first time.
Total Customer Assets
Total Customer Assets are defined as the sum of the (a) value of assets held by users in demat accounts 
across our platforms, (b) value of Mutual Funds, Alternative Investment Funds, Fixed Deposits, and Portfolio 
Management Services holdings of users invested through our platforms, and (c) value of customer funds held 
by users on our platforms. The value of assets reported is as on the last day of the reporting period.
Financial Metrics2
Revenue from Operations
Revenue from Operations.
Cost to Serve
Summation of (a) Software, server and technology costs and (b) Transaction and other related charges.
Cost to Grow
Marketing and business promotion expense.
Cost to Operate
Total expenses excluding (a) finance costs, (b) depreciation and amortisation expense, (c) marketing and 
business promotion expenses, (d) software, server and technology expenses and (e) Transaction and other 
related charges.
Total Income
Total Income, as presented in the financials.
EBITDA
EBITDA is defined as profit for the period /year plus (i) Total tax expense, (ii) Finance costs, (iii) Depreciation and 
amortisation expense, and (iv) Share of net loss of associate accounted for using equity method (net of tax) less 
Other income.
EBITDA Margin
Refers to EBITDA, as a percentage of Revenue from Operations
PAT
Profit for the period / year, as presented in the financials.
PAT Margin
Refers to Profit for the period / year, as a percentage of Total Income.
Product Metrics
MF SIP Inflows
Defined as the total value of SIPs purchased through our platforms during the reporting period.
Stocks ADTO3
Defined as cumulative turnover in Stocks during the period divided by the total number of trading days in 
the reporting period.
Equity Derivatives 
Premium ADTO
Defined as cumulative turnover in Equity Derivatives (that is the notional turnover for futures and premium 
turnover for options) during the reporting period divided by the total number of trading days in the 
reporting period.
MTF Book
Refers to ˝Loan - Margin Trading Facility˛, viz., MTF outstanding (funded) book as on the last day of the 
reporting period.
Groww AMC Active AUM
Assets under management in "Active funds", with the latter being defined as those funds in which the Fund 
Manager takes an active role in making investment decisions, dynamically choosing to buy, hold, or sell 
underlying securities and selecting specific stocks.
1Metric is not de-duplicated across our platforms.
2KPI may apply to Billionbrains Garage Ventures Ltd. / Groww platform / Fisdom / Groww AMC, as specified in relevant section.
3 'Stocks' includes Equities, ETFs, Rights Entitlements, Preference Shares, InvITs, REITs, Warrants, Pass Through Certificates.
"Our platforms" here refer to the Groww app, the Fisdom app, and the W app. User-level metrics are not de-duplicated across the three platforms.

Revenue from Operations

Cost to Serve
Summation of (a) Software, server and technology costs and (b) Transaction and other re

lated charges.

Marketing and business promotion expense.
Cost to Operate
Total expenses excluding (a) finance costs, (b) depreciation and amortisation expense, (c) marketing and

related charges.
Total Income
Total Income, as presented in the financials.
EBITDA
EBITDA is defined as profit for the period /year plus (i) Total tax expense, (ii) Finance costs, (iii) Depreciation and

Other income.

PAT

PAT Margin
Refers to Profit for the period / year, as a percentage of Total Income.
